render_point_cloud: render a 3D point cloud with RGB colors into a 360-degree orbiting video using PyTorch3D
generate_spiral_cameras: generate a stack of camera-to-world transformation matrices for a spiral camera path around an object
save_combined_video: combine multiple lists of rendered images side by side and save as a single MP4 video file
render_masked_point_cloud: render a point cloud with a boolean mask to selectively display only certain points in the output video
normalize_and_rotate_point_cloud: normalize point cloud coordinates to unit scale and apply a rotation matrix before rendering
